outcome.technical: tools/sweep-selftests.py: GIT_ENV now carries GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=3 with KEY_1/VALUE_1 maintenance.auto=false and KEY_2/VALUE_2 gc.auto=0 beside user.useConfigOnly; new is_ambient_git_config() (regex _GIT_CONFIG_PAIR_RE) drops the caller's own GIT_CONFIG_COUNT/KEY_n/VALUE_n in ambient_env() before the runner's set is laid on, so the runner's set is all of it. New cases: gm0 (titled with the tests.add clause; the caller's count 6, an opposite maintenance.auto at index 1 and a stray index 5 all gone, each key counted exactly once), gm1/gm2 (a run_one child that calls bare git, traces a commit: 0 maintenance spawns with the runner env and its git reads maintenance.auto back as false; deny twin with the protocol pairs removed plus maintenance.autoDetach=false spawns exactly 1), gm3 (_harness.NO_AUTO_MAINTENANCE keys are a subset of the runner set), gm4 (gate-parity isolation_drift over the real tree: the git config family holds both keys and has no prose finding). CLAUDE.md, CONTRIBUTING.md and the _harness.fixture_root() docstring name `maintenance.auto`, `gc.auto` and `GIT_CONFIG_COUNT`; the _harness NO_AUTO_MAINTENANCE comment says it stays for suites run outside the sweep. Outside the declared files: plugins/audit/tests/test_commit_task_work.py _traced_commit_spawns now strips the protocol pairs from its env, because the full sweep turned its deny twin ctw-nm2 red (spawns []) once the runner switched maintenance off; the plan gate allowed the edit. tools/gate-parity.py needed no change: filtered_env_families() already derives the family from GIT_ENV. Runs (worktree): full sweep exit 0, 335/335 files ok, 16460 cases (first run exit 1 on ctw-nm2, before the fix above); --encoding cp1252 exit 0, 335/335; --selftest exit 0, 104/104; gate-parity.py exit 0; gate-parity --selftest exit 0 132/132; ruff exit 0; vermin exit 0. Git versions: CI run 38823888314 (base SHA f645b245) checkout logs print git 2.55.0 on ubuntu-latest and 2.56.0.windows.2 on windows-latest, both past 2.31; gm1 also asks the child's own git to read maintenance.auto back, so an older git fails there. Measurement (GIT_TRACE=<file> python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py plugins/audit/tests/test__invariants.py): HEAD runner from a git archive export 199 'run_command: git maintenance run' lines, this runner 1 (195 commits in each trace). The one left is git receive-pack in a local push: the local transport runs 'unset GIT_CONFIG_COUNT GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS GIT_PREFIX' before receive-pack, so neither this set nor any -c prefix reaches the remote side. A probe showed GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL pointing at a file does reach it (0 spawns), but that changes how the home channel works, so I did not do it here.
outcome.descriptive: Every git the sweep starts runs with background maintenance off, set once in the runner; one push-side spawn per local push is left over and needs a follow-up decision.
